citations.claim: body 0 just before violation, right/above the wall, moving very fast
body 0 just before violation y position above wall top
body 0 after step crossed to left/below wall, centre passed through wall box between steps 147-148
body 0 y after crossing below wall

explanation: Body 0 gained extreme speed (~249 units/s via elastic multi-body pileup) so it travels ~8.3 units in one dt=1/30 step. The wall is only 2.0x0.5. Even with 200 substeps in the step, the centre path from (11.49,5.73) to (9.61,4.05) crosses straight through wall box x=9..11,y=5..5.5. Substep/collision handling fails to stop the crossing: likely substep count is capped at 200 and/or discrete per-substep overlap checks miss the diagonal transit combined with a velocity flip (vx +136 to -212) during the same step, so the checker records no_tunneling between steps 147-148.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 147 and 148

vision_note: The red violating body moves extremely far each frame, jumping from the left side in step 145 to the top in 146 and to the right tip of the central grey wall in 147. In step 148 it appears below the wall, having passed through the wall region instead of bouncing off it.
